_about: Short Paul segments: places Acts names but the routes skipped are added (Perga, Iconium, Cnidus, Ptolemais, Rhegium, Forum of Appius); sea legs marked; quotes match the MSB text.

steps.label: Down to the sea
steps.copy: Sent out by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul go down to Seleucia to sail for Cyprus.

steps.label: Salamis synagogues
steps.copy: At Salamis they proclaim the word of God in the Jewish synagogues.

steps.label: Elymas at Paphos
steps.copy: Across the island at Paphos, the sorcerer Elymas opposes them and is struck blind.

steps.label: The proconsul believes
steps.copy: Sergius Paulus believes, astonished at the teaching about the Lord.

steps.label: Strengthening souls
steps.copy: Back in Lystra they encourage the disciples: “We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God.”

steps.label: Back through Iconium
steps.copy: They strengthen the believers in Iconium as well.

steps.label: Elders appointed
steps.copy: In Pisidian Antioch they appoint elders in each church with prayer and fasting.

steps.label: Preaching in Perga
steps.copy: They pass through Pisidia and Pamphylia and speak the word in Perga.

steps.label: Down to Attalia
steps.copy: They go down to the port of Attalia.

steps.label: Home to Antioch
steps.copy: They sail back to Antioch and report all that God has done through them.

steps.label: A year and a half
steps.copy: Paul stays in Corinth a year and a half, teaching the word of God.

steps.label: Sailing from Cenchreae
steps.copy: He has his hair cut because of a vow and sets sail for Syria with Priscilla and Aquila.

steps.label: A stop at Ephesus
steps.copy: He reasons with the Jews in the synagogue and promises to return, if God wills.

steps.label: Up to greet the church
steps.copy: He lands at Caesarea and goes up to greet the church.

steps.label: Down to Antioch
steps.copy: Then he goes down to Antioch.

steps.label: Eutychus raised
steps.copy: Eutychus falls from a window during Paul's long talk; Paul embraces him, and he is taken home alive.

steps.label: Walking to Assos
steps.copy: Paul goes on foot while the others sail, and they take him aboard at Assos.

steps.label: Mitylene
steps.copy: They sail on to Mitylene.

steps.label: The elders summoned
steps.copy: Past Chios and Samos they reach Miletus, and Paul sends for the elders of Ephesus.

steps.label: Past Cyprus to Tyre
steps.copy: They sail past Cyprus and land at Tyre, where the ship unloads its cargo.

steps.label: A warning at Tyre
steps.copy: Through the Spirit the disciples urge Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

steps.label: Ptolemais
steps.copy: They greet the brothers at Ptolemais and stay a day.

steps.label: Staying with Philip
steps.copy: At Caesarea they stay with Philip the evangelist and his four daughters who prophesy.

steps.label: Agabus’s belt
steps.copy: The prophet Agabus binds his own hands and feet with Paul's belt as a sign of what awaits him.

steps.label: Setting sail
steps.copy: After three months they leave Malta on an Alexandrian ship.

steps.label: By Syracuse
steps.copy: They put in at Syracuse and stay three days.

steps.label: Rhegium
steps.copy: From there they sail on to Rhegium.

steps.label: Puteoli
steps.copy: With a south wind they reach Puteoli and find brothers there.

steps.label: Met on the road
steps.copy: Believers come out as far as the Forum of Appius and Three Taverns; Paul thanks God and takes courage.

steps.label: Arrival at Rome
steps.copy: In Rome, Paul is allowed to live by himself, with a soldier to guard him.

steps.label: A disciple at Lystra
steps.copy: At Lystra Paul finds Timothy, son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.

steps.label: Well spoken of
steps.copy: The brothers in Lystra and Iconium speak well of him.

steps.label: Joining the mission
steps.copy: Paul wants Timothy to come along on the journey.

steps.label: Churches strengthened
steps.copy: Town by town they deliver the council's decisions, and the churches grow stronger and larger every day.

steps.label: Cos
steps.copy: Tearing themselves away from the Ephesian elders, they sail straight to Cos.

steps.label: Rhodes
steps.copy: The next day they reach Rhodes.

steps.label: A ship for Phoenicia
steps.copy: At Patara they find a ship crossing to Phoenicia and go aboard.

steps.label: Past Cyprus
steps.copy: They sight Cyprus, pass it on their left, and sail on to Syria.

steps.label: Setting sail
steps.copy: Paul and other prisoners are handed to the centurion Julius and board a ship from Adramyttium.

steps.label: Kindness at Sidon
steps.copy: Julius kindly lets Paul visit his friends to be cared for.

steps.label: Changing ships at Myra
steps.copy: Sheltered by Cyprus, they reach Myra and board an Alexandrian ship bound for Italy.

steps.label: Cnidus
steps.copy: They sail slowly for many days and barely reach Cnidus.

steps.label: Reaching Fair Havens
steps.copy: Sailing under the shelter of Crete, with difficulty they come to Fair Havens.

steps.label: Shaking off the dust
steps.copy: Driven out of Pisidian Antioch, they shake the dust off their feet and go on to Iconium.

steps.label: Many believe
steps.copy: In the synagogue a great number of Jews and Greeks believe, and the Lord confirms the message with signs.

steps.label: Fleeing a plot
steps.copy: Learning of a plan to stone them, they flee to Lystra.
